spec_deviations.deviation: Module placed at ecomd/corpus/l1_corpus_adapter.py instead of the suggested ecomd/data/l1_corpus_adapter.py.
spec_deviations.resolution: Built in E-1's ecomd/corpus/ package as a sibling of fexec_projector.py.
spec_deviations.reason: ecomd/data/ holds market-data ingestion scripts (binance/lobster/yfinance); L1-1 is a pure (prestate, tape, seed) function over the E-1 corpus and belongs beside the grammar it must not drift from; both locations are inside the mypy files=[ecomd] scope, so the move changes nothing operationally.

spec_deviations.deviation: The conserving channels are taken either from an explicitly passed E-4 series (structural Protocol ConservingSeriesView) or derived internally via a LAZY import of lab_asset.conserving_emitter inside the function body.
spec_deviations.resolution: build_l1_corpus(..., series=None): series=None derives via the E-4 emitter (the spec's regenerate() path); an explicit series is accepted, grid/content/session/rule-checked against E-1's projection at build time.
spec_deviations.reason: lab_asset is not an installed package (only importable with scripts/ on sys.path); a module-level import would break 'import ecomd' for training code. The lazy import keeps the pure-function-of-(prestate, tape, seed) semantics (E-4 is itself such a pure function) while the adapter -> engine import direction rule is respected; ecomd/models/ never imports lab_asset.

spec_deviations.deviation: Anonymous book-state -> agent-state mapping fixed as: N = n_slots anonymous level-agents (one per E-1 queue slot, padding slots = never-clearable level-agents), d_state = 6 with named channels (2 per-slot: log1p(prev round executed quantity at the slot, slot price deviation from the last post-mid in spread units; 4 shared: log1p cumulative volume, log1p cumulative cash ticks, last post-spread, last mid move).
spec_deviations.resolution: Documented as the frozen contract (L1_AGENT_STATE_CHANNELS, module docstring table); input for round t uses only completed-round data tau = t-1.
spec_deviations.reason: The spec demands a FIXED documented d_state; the touched-price-level ladder is the only anonymous book surface the F_exec selection determines (the full resting book is engine state outside the selection, per E-1's documented decision), so one agent per queue slot is the narrowest deterministic reading.

spec_deviations.deviation: Round-0 input is the all-zero no-event token (zeros for s and for the [log_price, volatility, last_log_return] context) rather than a projection of the session-initial resting book.
spec_deviations.resolution: t=0 emits zeros; log_price floors at log(max(mid, 1)) so the token stays finite; volatility EWMA is seeded at 0.0 (no sigma_price prior exists in the tape).
spec_deviations.reason: The initial book is prestate engine state outside the F_exec pure selection; projecting it would open a second tape-derivation surface beyond E-1's grammar. Conservative narrower reading; matches the documented no-event token convention of the frozen grammar.

spec_deviations.deviation: Flow slot: the exposed z_t slot is emitted zero-filled (flow_slot (R, N) in the tensor dtype) rather than left abstract.
spec_deviations.resolution: The adapter never predicts; L1-2 writes its per-round resting-quantity prediction into the slot; slot_prices rides on the supervision side for the through-M cash arithmetic.
spec_deviations.reason: A deterministic zero fill keeps the adapter byte-deterministic and hashable while still exposing the slot shape contract; any consumer-visible 'uninitialized' state would violate the determinism rule.

spec_deviations.deviation: Request-side exclusion is tested with the clean E-4 series injected alongside the perturbed tape (tensor surfaces and content_hash invariant, provenance hashes change), and separately the internal-derivation path on a request-side-perturbed tape is asserted to RAISE (E-4 replay guard).
spec_deviations.resolution: Two-test discipline mirrors E-1's exclusion test through the series-injection surface.
spec_deviations.reason: Unlike E-1, L1-1 composes with the engine re-execution, and any request-side payload perturbation breaks replay validity by construction; the adapter therefore guarantees exclusion (content) AND rejection (provenance-tampered internal derivation) rather than silently tolerating perturbed tapes.

interface_notes: Lineage invariance by construction: features/slot tensors/payload tuples are E-1's FexecCorpus verbatim (same objects, not re-derived); conserving channels are E-4's matrices verbatim; the cross-check (grid, increment, cumulative, session, rule) is enforced at build time so two drifting artifacts fail loudly.

Consumability: agent_states[t] is EcoMDSimulator's s surface (n_agents, d_state) float32; context[t] is exactly the torch.stack([log_price, volatility, last_log_return]) triple of the ecomd.py:1110-1116 pattern and has been driven through one EcoMDSimulator(pairwise_kind='ecomd_v2') step in the test; L1-2/L1-3 attach at flow_slot + slot_prices (through-M cash = allocation x slot price).

channels_abs is the zero-based running sum (post-round ABS target base); the engine-STATE initial totals live in the E-4 series JSON bound via series_hash, not in the channel tensors (C5 channels are executed volume/cash, which start at 0 by construction).

Hash design: adapter_hash = sha256 over canonical JSON binding adapter id/version, channel names, alpha, seed, n_slots, dtype, E-1 corpus_hash (provenance), series_hash (E-4 canonical JSON) and content_hash (tensor content only).
No stochastic consumer exists anywhere in the adapter path (seed binds identity only); the C5 channel scaling s_ch remains out of scope (E-4 deviation 5: D0-freeze side).
